generator.note: Deterministic template + slot expansion; labels are template properties grounded in cited authority (see sources), not model-inferred. Committed JSON + hashes are authoritative (§7-10(f)); regeneration is deterministic given this seed but is provenance, not a bit-identical promise.

sources.intent-executable: Payment-operations control principle: an instruction that directs an immediate transfer of funds (wire/ACH/payment 'now') is executable movement intent.
sources.sr11-7-control: SR 11-7 (model risk management) control framing: distinguish an actionable instruction from a report/observation; only the former triggers a funds-movement control.
sources.report-not-intent: Balance/reporting statements describe state, not an instruction to move funds; no executable intent.
sources.conditional-not-intent: Hypothetical/conditional statements ('if approved, we would…') are not an executable instruction.
sources.cancelled-not-intent: Cancelled/failed/reversed transfers describe a non-occurring movement; no executable intent now.
sources.historical-not-intent: Past-tense references to completed transfers are historical facts, not a new instruction.
sources.unrelated: Non-financial operational correspondence; no funds referenced.

classes.description: Balance/reporting statements about money, no instruction.
Requests for information about transfers, no instruction.

humanReview.sampleMethod: Deterministic stratified 10% sample across concern×label×suite×language, selected by seeded index (see scripts/sample-review.ts).
humanReview.notes: Engineer authored templates from cited regulatory sources; qualified compliance-literate review is an outstanding human gate (§7-10(a)).
